verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a 'Computers' product that gives each end user a persistent Linux desktop (XFCE, Chromium, LibreOffice) driven by your model. The changelog describes screenshot, mouse, keyboard control and a live take-over view, and dedicated computers-scoped API keys exist, so the full-desktop half of the story is clearly a first-party capability. However, the changelog's 'are getting' wording suggests the feature may still be rolling out. missing for 10: an explicit headless-browser mode (e.g. Playwright/Puppeteer) without the desktop, in-depth docs on desktop resources and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the desktop works as described.
